contradictions.details: CoreSite's DE3 community page says operations were scheduled for June 2026, while CoreSite's Denver market page says DE3 is scheduled to open at the end of 2026; no final inspection, CO, energization, or live-service source resolved this.

CoreSite facility/community pages list approximately 170,000 square feet, while CoreSite's October 2025 milestone announcement and DPR profile describe approximately 180,000 square feet. Capacity is consistent at 18 MW/CMW.
